title: NerveBranch
description: One node in a nerve tree graph (root, trunk, division, cord, or named branch down to terminal muscular/cutaneous twigs). The full set of NerveBranch records for a plexus forms a directed tree rooted at the spinal nerve roots; engine/nerve_tree.py builds and validates this graph (every non-root node must resolve to exactly one parent, every leaf must terminate in a documented target).

parent_id.description: id of the proximal nerve segment this branches from; null only for plexus root nodes (spinal nerve roots)

path_via_points_mm.description: ordered polyline landmarks the nerve trunk travels through in the global frame (or a named bone's local frame) — enough to generate a smooth 1mm-sampled centerline that is later reparented onto the rig so it deforms with the limb.

targets.description: muscle compartment ids and/or skin dermatome regions this branch innervates

motor_entry_point.description: Where the branch pierces the target muscle to reach its neuromuscular junction zone (the classic 'motor point').
